t: Christie's - Wikipedia

t: How to buy at Christie's | Find what you love
s: Buying guide · Translate Translate this page · EN English · FR French · An item has caught your attention and you’re thinking of placing a bid. What’s next? If you’ve created an account and verified your identity, you can register to bid in any auction. Christie’s hosts both live auctions, which take place on a specific date and time in one of our salerooms around the world, and online auctions, which are open for bidding for a fixed period over several days.
